model.statement: Marketplace de servicios domésticos por booking, más placement de ayuda a tiempo completo y SaaS/admin MyHome Hub para trabajadores privados.

mechanism.text: More than just a home services platform.
Apply Now WHAT WE OFFER More than just a home services platform.
HOW IT WORKS Getting your home in order has never been easier.
A home services platform, spearheading change across our industry.
WHO WE ARE A home services platform, spearheading change across our industry.
Inspired by the need for change, they launched Sweepsouth, the first platform of its kind in South Africa, with the aim to modernise the home services industry.
SWEEPSTARS 6500 active home services professionals on our platform.
Sweepsouth Booking Cover Benefits If accepted on our Platform, you will have the benefits of Booking Cover cover that we have arranged for Users.

“Booking” means the completed transaction by a Beneficiary on the Sweepsouth Platform for the services of a Sweepstar at a specific time and at the Beneficiary’s Property, Building or Home, which transaction includes the election of the option for Household Contents cover.
“Sweepsouth Platform” means the digital platform the Beneficiary uses to make a Booking for the services of a Sweepstar.

“Sweepstar” means an independent contractor who has been booked by a Beneficiary on the Sweepsouth Platform to assist with cleaning, gardening and/or general labour services at the Property, Building or Home.
swimming pools including swimming pool pumps, saunas, spa baths, hot tubs, ornamental ponds, fishponds and fountains and permanently installed watering or irrigation systems.
Data Protection Any information the Beneficiary provides will be processed in compliance with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013.
STEP 1 2 3 Join SweepSouth Apply today to become Housekeeper SweepStar.
